== English errata comparison sources ==
During your control phase → During each of your control phases. Express the search/take into hand and and reshuffle as take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If with C-3PO at any battleground site → If at a battleground site with C-3PO.

The [[:File:JP-L-artoo-hires.webp|physical original]] and the Glossary both keep “same and related sites.” The [[:File:JP-L-artoo-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher website image]] from the 17 August 2001 capture omits “same and.” The archived image is preserved with its File source history. The Glossary prints “C-3P0,” while the physical card and the later PC sources use “C-3PO.”

Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=14 Glossary Version 2.0], November 1998, PDF page 14, Artoo (Jabba's Palace). Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=103 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 103, Artoo (Jabba's Palace).
